facts.claim: The Work IQ MCP endpoint is https://workiq.svc.cloud.microsoft/mcp
facts.evidence: "the remote Work IQ MCP server endpoint, https://workiq.svc.cloud.microsoft/mcp"; its protected-resource document names that resource.

facts.claim: Sign-in is Microsoft Entra ID with authority login.microsoftonline.com/organizations/v2.0 and no dynamic client registration
facts.evidence: authorization_servers https://login.microsoftonline.com/organizations/v2.0; its openid-configuration has no registration_endpoint and a templated issuer.

facts.claim: The delegated permission is WorkIQAgent.Ask on api://workiq.svc.cloud.microsoft and needs admin consent; an admin must enable Work IQ first
facts.evidence: "use the OAuth scope value api://workiq.svc.cloud.microsoft/WorkIQAgent.Ask"; AdminConsentRequired Yes; "An organization administrator must enable Work IQ".

facts.claim: Tools: fetch, fetch_blob, create_entity, update_entity, delete_entity, do_action (sends mail, moves), call_function, ask, retrieve, list_agents, get_schema, search_paths; list_agents takes no parameters
facts.evidence: Tool reference: do_action "Runs a side-effect action such as sending mail"; list_agents "This tool takes no parameters".

facts.claim: Tenant policy blocks mutation operations by default
facts.evidence: "A separate tenant policy layer evaluates each tool request and blocks mutation operations by default."

facts.claim: The per-workload Mail, Calendar, Teams MCP servers are legacy, for backward compatibility only
facts.evidence: "only intended for backward compatibility purposes and shouldn't be used in production environments or new projects".

facts.claim: A multitenant app registration is needed because the authority is /organizations; a public client with a localhost redirect works with LOTR's pre-registered Entra flow
facts.evidence: Inferred from the /organizations authority (Entra refuses a single-tenant app there, AADSTS50194); not stated on a Work IQ page. Not tried against a real tenant.

facts.claim: Licensing and billing: Microsoft says the Work IQ API (and its MCP server) is generally available; whether a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence or consumption billing applies was not settled from the pages read
facts.evidence: "Work IQ MCP is generally available as part of the Work IQ API." Third-party reports disagree on licensing.

facts.claim: Sign-in uses login.microsoftonline.com (authorize and token endpoints) beside the MCP host
